question: Which of the following festivals in Punjab is celebrated to commemorate the formation of the Khalsa Panth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baisakhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The festival of Baisakhi is celebrated with enthusiasm in Punjab, Haryana and Chandigarh.
 
• It is a spring harvest festival for the Sikhs. 
 
• **Baisakhi also commemorates the formation of Khalsa Panth by Guru Gobind Singh in 1699.**
